+    def _write_recipe(self, directory, filename, contents):
+        """Create a temporary recipe fixture and return its path."""
+        path = os.path.join(directory, filename)
+        parent = os.path.dirname(path)
+        if not os.path.isdir(parent):
+            os.makedirs(parent)
+        with open(path, 'w') as f:
+            f.write(contents)
+        return path
+
+    def test_include_stage0_and_shared_values(self):
+        """included recipes contribute Stage0 state and shared values"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            fragment_name = 'shared-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            image = 'stage0-image-{}:latest'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            package = 'stage0-package-{}'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            self._write_recipe(tmpdir, fragment_name,
+                               "Stage0 += baseimage(image={!r})\n"
+                               "extra_package = {!r}\n".format(image, package))
+            main = self._write_recipe(
+                tmpdir, 'main.py',
+                "hpccm.include({!r})\n"
+                "Stage0 += packages(ospackages=[extra_package])\n".format(
+                    fragment_name))
+
+            result = recipe(main)
+
+            self.assertIn('FROM {}'.format(image), result)
+            self.assertIn(package, result)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_arbitrary_sibling_recipe_name(self):
+        """include works for ordinary sibling recipe names"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            fragment_name = 'common-build-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            image = 'sibling-image-{}:latest'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            package = 'sibling-package-{}'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            self._write_recipe(tmpdir, fragment_name,
+                               "Stage0 += baseimage(image={!r})\n"
+                               "custom_package = {!r}\n".format(
+                                   image, package))
+            main = self._write_recipe(
+                tmpdir, 'main.py',
+                "hpccm.include({!r})\n"
+                "Stage0 += packages(ospackages=[custom_package])\n".format(
+                    fragment_name))
+
+            result = recipe(main)
+
+            self.assertIn('FROM {}'.format(image), result)
+            self.assertIn(package, result)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_stage1_singularity_output(self):
+        """included recipes contribute Stage1 content for Singularity"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            fragment_name = 'stage1-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            image = 'stage1-image-{}:latest'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            package = 'stage1-package-{}'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            self._write_recipe(tmpdir, fragment_name,
+                               "Stage1 += baseimage(image={!r})\n".format(
+                                   image))
+            main = self._write_recipe(
+                tmpdir, 'main.py',
+                "hpccm.include({!r})\n"
+                "Stage1 += packages(ospackages=[{!r}])\n".format(
+                    fragment_name, package))
+
+            result = recipe(main, ctype=container_type.SINGULARITY,
+                            singularity_version='3.2')
+
+            self.assertIn('From: {}'.format(image), result)
+            self.assertIn(package, result)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_relative_to_main_recipe_from_different_cwd(self):
+        """relative includes are resolved from the recipe file location"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        old_cwd = os.getcwd()
+        try:
+            recipe_dir = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'recipes')
+            other_cwd = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'elsewhere')
+            os.makedirs(other_cwd)
+            fragment_name = os.path.join(
+                'fragments', 'toolchain-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex))
+            image = 'relative-image-{}:latest'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            package = 'relative-package-{}'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            self._write_recipe(
+                recipe_dir, fragment_name,
+                "Stage0 += baseimage(image={!r})\n".format(image))
+            main = self._write_recipe(
+                recipe_dir, 'main.py',
+                "hpccm.include({!r})\n"
+                "Stage0 += packages(ospackages=[{!r}])\n".format(
+                    fragment_name, package))
+
+            os.chdir(other_cwd)
+            result = recipe(main)
+
+            self.assertIn('FROM {}'.format(image), result)
+            self.assertIn(package, result)
+        finally:
+            os.chdir(old_cwd)
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_absolute_path(self):
+        """absolute include paths are used as absolute paths"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            image = 'absolute-image-{}:latest'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            package = 'absolute-package-{}'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            fragment = self._write_recipe(
+                tmpdir, 'absolute-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex),
+                "Stage0 += baseimage(image={!r})\n".format(image))
+            main_dir = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'main-recipe')
+            main = self._write_recipe(
+                main_dir, 'main.py',
+                "hpccm.include({!r})\n"
+                "Stage0 += packages(ospackages=[{!r}])\n".format(
+                    fragment, package))
+
+            result = recipe(main)
+
+            self.assertIn('FROM {}'.format(image), result)
+            self.assertIn(package, result)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_missing_default_exits(self):
+        """missing includes exit by default"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            missing = os.path.join(
+                tmpdir, 'missing-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex))
+            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as context:
+                hpccm.include(missing)
+            self.assertEqual(context.exception.code, 1)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_raise_exceptions_propagates(self):
+        """raise_exceptions=True propagates included recipe errors"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            error_name = 'IncludeRaised{}'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex)
+            bad = self._write_recipe(
+                tmpdir, 'bad-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex),
+                "class {0}(Exception):\n"
+                "    pass\n"
+                "raise {0}\n".format(error_name))
+
+            with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
+                hpccm.include(bad, raise_exceptions=True)
+            self.assertEqual(type(context.exception).__name__, error_name)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
+
+    def test_include_runtime_error_default_exits(self):
+        """runtime errors in included recipes exit by default"""
+        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            bad = self._write_recipe(
+                tmpdir, 'runtime-{}.py'.format(uuid.uuid4().hex),
+                "raise RuntimeError()\n")
+
+            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as context:
+                hpccm.include(bad)
+            self.assertEqual(context.exception.code, 1)
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)

+#!/bin/bash
+set -uo pipefail
+cd /testbed
+

+dev-switch python3 3.11
+python3 -m pip install -e . --no-input

+    ;;
+  new)
+    python3 -m pytest test/test_recipe.py -v \
+      -k 'test_include_stage0_and_shared_values or test_include_arbitrary_sibling_recipe_name or test_include_stage1_singularity_output or test_include_relative_to_main_recipe_from_different_cwd or test_include_absolute_path or test_include_missing_default_exits or test_include_raise_exceptions_propagates or test_include_runtime_error_default_exits'
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "usage: $0 base|new"
+    exit 2
+    ;;
+esac
diff --git a/test/test_repair_include_examples.py b/test/test_repair_include_examples.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/test_repair_include_examples.py
@@ -0,0 +1,171 @@
+import ast
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import hpccm
+from hpccm.common import container_type
+
+
+ROOT = Path('/testbed')
+FORMATS = (container_type.DOCKER, container_type.SINGULARITY)
+
+
+def render(path, ctype):
+    return hpccm.recipe(str(path), ctype=ctype, raise_exceptions=True,
+                        singularity_version='3.2')
+
+
+def uses_public_include(path):
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(), filename=str(path))
+    modules = {'hpccm'}
+    functions = set()
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            for name in node.names:
+                if name.name == 'hpccm':
+                    modules.add(name.asname or name.name)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == 'hpccm':
+            for name in node.names:
+                if name.name == 'include':
+                    functions.add(name.asname or name.name)
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
+            continue
+        fun = node.func
+        if isinstance(fun, ast.Name) and fun.id in functions:
+            return True
+        if (isinstance(fun, ast.Attribute) and fun.attr == 'include'
+                and isinstance(fun.value, ast.Name) and fun.value.id in modules):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def mark_shared_source(source, tag):
+    # Leave module docstrings and future imports in their legal positions.
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    insertion = 0
+    for node in tree.body:
+        docstring = (isinstance(node, ast.Expr)
+                     and isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant)
+                     and isinstance(node.value.value, str))
+        future = isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == '__future__'
+        if docstring or future:
+            insertion = node.end_lineno
+        else:
+            break
+    before = ''.join(
+        "Stage{0} += hpccm.primitives.comment('{1}-start-{0}')\n".format(stage, tag)
+        for stage in (0, 1))
+    after = ''.join(
+        "Stage{0} += hpccm.primitives.comment('{1}-end-{0}')\n".format(stage, tag)
+        for stage in (0, 1))
+    lines = source.splitlines(True)
+    return ''.join(lines[:insertion]) + '\n' + before + ''.join(lines[insertion:]) + '\n' + after
+
+
+class TestRecipeIncludeRepair(unittest.TestCase):
+    def assert_specification(self, output, ctype):
+        if ctype == container_type.DOCKER:
+            self.assertRegex(output, r'(?m)^FROM\s+\S+')
+        else:
+            self.assertRegex(output, r'(?im)^Bootstrap:\s*docker\s*$')
+            self.assertRegex(output, r'(?im)^From:\s*\S+')
+
+    def test_included_objects_and_both_stages_reach_generated_output(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            folder = Path(directory)
+            (folder / 'shared.py').write_text(
+                "Stage0 += baseimage(image='ubuntu:20.04')\n"
+                "compiler = gnu()\n"
+                "Stage0 += compiler\n"
+                "shared_value = 'shared-recipe-value'\n"
+                "Stage1 += baseimage(image='ubuntu:20.04')\n"
+                "Stage1 += shell(commands=['echo included-stage-one'])\n")
+            main = folder / 'main.py'
+            main.write_text(
+                "hpccm.include('shared.py')\n"
+                "Stage0 += packages(ospackages=['included-' + type(compiler).__name__])\n"
+                "Stage1 += shell(commands=['echo ' + shared_value])\n")
+            previous = os.getcwd()
+            try:
+                os.chdir('/tmp')
+                for ctype in FORMATS:
+                    with self.subTest(ctype=ctype):
+                        output = render(main, ctype)
+                        self.assert_specification(output, ctype)
+                        self.assertIn('g++', output)
+                        self.assertIn('included-gnu', output)
+                        self.assertIn('echo included-stage-one', output)
+                        self.assertIn('echo shared-recipe-value', output)
+            finally:
+                os.chdir(previous)
+
+    def test_shipped_examples_reuse_a_sibling_and_generate_real_recipes(self):
+        candidates = []
+        for base in (ROOT / 'recipes', ROOT / 'examples'):
+            if base.is_dir():
+                candidates.extend(path for path in base.rglob('*.py')
+                                  if uses_public_include(path))
+        self.assertTrue(candidates,
+                        'provide an example reusing a sibling recipe through hpccm.include')
+        for example in sorted(candidates):
+            with self.subTest(example=str(example)):
+                siblings = set()
+                real_open = open
+
+                def record_open(file, *args, **kwargs):
+                    if isinstance(file, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)):
+                        path = Path(os.fsdecode(file)).resolve()
+                        if (path != example and path.parent == example.parent
+                                and path.suffix == '.py'):
+                            siblings.add(path)
+                    return real_open(file, *args, **kwargs)
+
+                previous = os.getcwd()
+                try:
+                    os.chdir('/tmp')
+                    # Observe ordinary file loading without wrapping include: its
+                    # caller namespace remains exactly the recipe's namespace.
+                    with patch('builtins.open', record_open), patch('io.open', record_open):
+                        for ctype in FORMATS:
+                            output = render(example, ctype)
+                            self.assert_specification(output, ctype)
+                finally:
+                    os.chdir(previous)
+                self.assertTrue(siblings, 'example must actually load a sibling recipe')
+                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+                    copied = Path(directory) / 'examples'
+                    shutil.copytree(str(example.parent), str(copied))
+                    tags = []
+                    for number, sibling in enumerate(sorted(siblings)):
+                        tag = 'envcheck-shared-{}'.format(number)
+                        tags.append(tag)
+                        (copied / sibling.name).write_text(
+                            mark_shared_source(sibling.read_text(), tag))
+                    for ctype in FORMATS:
+                        output = render(copied / example.name, ctype)
+                        self.assert_specification(output, ctype)
+                        # The bracketing comments locate the actual shared setup
+                        # in the generated specification, not just Python source
+                        # text or a nonempty standalone fragment.
+                        shared_instructions = []
+                        for tag in tags:
+                            for stage in (0, 1):
+                                start = '# {}-start-{}'.format(tag, stage)
+                                end = '# {}-end-{}'.format(tag, stage)
+                                self.assertIn(start, output)
+                                self.assertIn(end, output)
+                                section = output.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
+                                shared_instructions.extend(
+                                    line.strip() for line in section.splitlines()
+                                    if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith('#'))
+                        self.assertTrue(shared_instructions,
+                                        'included development setup must contribute generated instructions')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh base && bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh new
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
python3 -m pytest test/test_repair_include_examples.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
